rsync_enable.description: Whether to enable rsync daemon mode via init.d. Allowed values: "true", "false", "inetd".

rsync_opts.description: Extra command-line options for rsync daemon (e.g., '--address=127.0.0.1 --port=873').

rsync_nice.description: Nice level (0–19) for rsync daemon; empty string leaves it unset.
